sources.snippet: Rainbow-AI-12B-Unified is a custom-trained, multi-domain 12B parameter language model built on an Unsloth-optimized Gemma-2 base architecture span_3 span_3. It features tailored conversational capabilities spanning coding, visual analytics, creative tasks, and a specialized Nova persona mode.

sources.title: RainbowLord/Rainbow-AI-12B-Unified
sources.snippet: Rainbow-AI-12B-Unified is a 12 billion parameter language model developed by RainbowLord, built upon an Unsloth-optimized Gemma-4 base architecture. This model is custom-trained using Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) over 60 steps, specifically designed to function as a versatile, multi-domain assistant.
